item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera measures the density of a copper vessel at home and finds it to be 8.9 g/cm³. The density of water is 1.0 g/cm³. She writes in her notebook: “The relative density of copper is 8.9 g/cm³.” Which statement about her answer is correct?

options.A: It is correct, because relative density has the same unit as density.
options.B: It is wrong, because relative density has no unit; she should write 8.9.
options.C: It is wrong, because relative density should be written in kg/m³.
options.D: It is correct, because copper is denser than water.
